paper.title: Proteome-wide discovery of mislocated proteins in cancer
paper.citation: Lee K, Byun K, Hong W, Chuang HY, Pack CG, Bayarsaikhan E, et al. Genome Research 23(8):1283-1294 (2013)

cause.summary: Lists the sources of the single-protein features; nothing to recompute.

assumptions.what: Gold standard from the GO release of 2007-01-01 with every evidence code except IEA
assumptions.sensitivity: Over 21 monthly releases (2007-01 to 2012-12) and five evidence-code sets, the stated six experimental codes never give the paper's counts: 1,248 to 1,512 proteins from 2007-01 to 2008-03 and 2,414 to 7,061 after, with cytosol at 610 to 1,068 against 308 from 2008-06 to 2011-06. Non-IEA codes in 2007-01, 2007-06 and 2007-09 give 4,597, 4,658 and 4,641 proteins before mapping, within 2% of 4,570 (search/gold_standard_search.json).

assumptions.what: GO accessions mapped to current human Swiss-Prot (release 2026_04) by accession, entry name and gene symbol

cause.summary: The GO release is not stated, and the six experimental codes the Methods name cannot give 4,570 proteins in any release up to 2008. The 4,570 proteins are those of Lee et al. 2008 (Table S3), which come back only from a 2007 release with all non-IEA codes. Mapping 2007 accessions onto current Swiss-Prot then loses about 330 proteins (merged and deleted entries).
evidence: Lee et al. 2008, Supplementary Table S3 (4,570 HS proteins, AT 156, CC 41, NU 1,739, PM 1,561)

hypotheses.hypothesis: The six stated experimental codes give the gold standard
hypotheses.test: All 21 releases, 2007-01 to 2012-12

hypotheses.hypothesis: The gold standard is Lee et al. 2008's, from a 2007 release with non-IEA codes
hypotheses.test: 2007-01 non-IEA before mapping: 4,597 proteins and 5,264 locations against 4,570 and 5,252

cause.summary: BIND is gone (only its 1,500 links inside Ramani's set survive) and DIP needs a login; the release dates of the other sources are not stated. The rebuilt network is 4% larger in links and 4% smaller in proteins.

cause.summary: In normal brain the top 1,000 correlated pairs hold 21 times more known links than chance, as in the paper; in low- and high-grade glioma only 2 times. How the paper pooled several studies of different platforms into one ranking is not stated, and our gliomas pool five small studies on five platforms.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Pairs measured only in small studies fill the top of the glioma rankings with chance correlations
hypotheses.test: Pairs need studies with at least 10 samples together: glioma enrichment at 1,000 pairs stays at 2 to 3 times chance

hypotheses.hypothesis: Ranking only genes measured in every study of the condition
hypotheses.test: An earlier run with this rule: 1,842 high-grade genes; at 1,000 pairs normal 23, low 9 and high 17 times chance; common pairs still fewer than one condition's

items.label: Python package condloc and its tutorial

page.lede: CoLP mapped where proteins sit in normal brain and in glioma, and which ones move. Its server is gone and its code was never released. We rebuilt it from the paper and its 2008 method paper, reran it on the archived data, and checked {items} results on 2026-11-18: {agrees} agree, {partly} partly agree, {differs} differ and {not_attempted} were not attempted.
page.items_caption: Every figure, table and number of the paper, with the paper's value and ours. Verdicts are computed from results.json.
page.claims_line: The static part of the method holds: interacting proteins that are co-expressed share a location most often, and network features predict GO locations about as well as the paper says. The condition-specific part does not come back: our maps move few proteins between normal brain and glioma, and none of the 15 validated mislocations. The causes are the settings the unavailable supplement holds (the possibility calibration and the mislocation test) and a rebuilt gold standard and network.
came_back: The five GEO series give 82, 23 and 134 samples, as published.
Interacting pairs with correlated expression share a location 80% of the time, 0.08 more than pairs with opposed expression (paper 0.1).
Single-protein features average an AUC of 0.63, as published.
The four feature configurations rank as in the paper, 0.04 to 0.08 lower.
RET at the plasma membrane and SMAD4 in the nucleus in all three conditions, as published.
condloc, the method as a Python package with a tutorial.
buried: The supplement (Tables S1 and S2, the calibration and the mislocation test) sits behind a Cloudflare challenge.
BIND is gone and DIP needs a login; the network is rebuilt from the sources still online.
The gold standard is Lee et al. 2008's, from GO in 2007; 4,269 of its 4,570 proteins still map to UniProt.
The wet-lab panels cannot be regenerated.
page.matched_intro: What we put next to the paper, and how.
matched: GO 2007-01-01, every evidence code but IEA, 13 locations.
HPRD and Reactome (2011), Rual, Stelzl and Ewing (BioGRID 2011), Ramani 2005: 84,309 links between 10,351 proteins.
GSE5281 and GSE5390 (normal), GSE3185 and GSE9885 (low grade), GSE3185, GSE9885 and GSE4271 (high grade).
DC-kNN with k = 5 and 29 feature sets, leave-two-out by halves.
Coherence-weighted network features per condition, degrees of possibility, P < 0.005 calls.
page.closing: We dug CoLP back up on 2026-11-18. Its static half came back; its mislocations did not.
